facts.fact: Jules 被两个戴滑雪面罩的人从 Turbo Putt 绑走；David Sawyer 从阴影现身「我找你很久了，你很特别」
facts.anchor: David walked over to them all cool and calm and knelt down on the hole seven green. He looked Jules in the eye that night and said, “I’ve been looking for you for a very long time. You might not believe me yet, but you’re very special.”

facts.fact: Jules 当晚随 David 私奔、两天车程到沙漠营地；23 年来从没离开 Lubbock 超过 30 英里
facts.anchor: In Jules’s twenty-three years of life, they had never been more than thirty miles out of Lubbock.

facts.fact: 营地约十二座木屋、大多没电；David 监控中心是带天线阵列的大棚，堆满 VHS 与坏电视
facts.anchor: The whole operation was made up of about a dozen wooden cabins. Most of them didn’t even have electricity. The big exception was David’s surveillance center, a large shed off near the edge of camp that had been outfitted with a fleet of antennas.

facts.fact: Emily（David 二把手、前海军陆战队、曾是 TheUncannyValley 版主）测 Jules 电流：total wash
facts.anchor: “There’s no current whatsoever,” Emily said to David as she read Jules’s vitals.

facts.fact: Eddy（前 8chan 黑客、技术运营）熄灯前告诫 Jules：被 David 认定 special 的人从不长久、大多消失
facts.anchor: “We’ve all been through the tests. We’ve all felt that initial disappointment when you find out you’re not one of the special ones.

facts.fact: 次日早餐：David 昨夜截获信号，下一个 crooked=GlobalVill 内容审核员 Bethany Peters；Emily 组救援队
facts.anchor: His latest lead was a content moderator who worked at GlobalVill.com, of all places. Her name was Bethany Peters, and Emily was already putting together a rescue mission to extract her.

facts.fact: Jules 醒悟是认错人（David 找的是 Bethany）；却吹嘘与 Bethany 是密友/basically lovers，自荐加入救援队
facts.anchor: They insisted on volunteering, and summoned all the fake confidence they could muster to look Emily in the eye and ask to ride shotgun once again in the car next to David Sawyer.

facts.fact: Emily 带 Jules 进军械库给左轮；Jules 说「我上一把枪当礼物送给 Bethany Peters 了」
facts.anchor: “Of course I do. Believe it or not, I gave my last gun to Bethany Peters as a present.”
